definitionZh: 使用 [filterTaps](#filterTaps) 选项时，仅当位移小于 3 像素时才会触发点击。您可以使用 tapsThreshold 自定义该值。
sourceDefinition: When using the [filterTaps](#filterTaps) option, taps are only triggered when the displacement is inferior to 3 pixels. You can customize that value by using tapsThreshold.
